selected.text: While posing as an aristocrat, Belgian serial killer Nestor Pirotte murdered an antiques dealer in Brussels.
The wedding of King Constantine II of Greece and Princess Anne-Marie of Denmark took place in Athens.
Aeroflot Flight 213 crashed into a mountain near Chersky Airport, killing 32 people.
The Blackpool Illuminations (example pictured) in the English seaside town of Blackpool were switched on for the first time.
The New York Times, the largest metropolitan newspaper in the United States, was founded.
Constantine the Great decisively defeated Licinius in the Battle of Chrysopolis, establishing Constantine's sole control over the Roman Empire.
